item.title: McCarthy ice rink to be in the 'ballpark' by next ice season
item.description: File Photo of the McCarthy ice rink in Batavia, expected to have a ballpark beer license by next ice season, manager Matt Gray says. One-time liquor licenses for special events will be a thing of the past for ice rink manager Matt Gray once he hopefully obtains the necessary approvals for a ballpark beer license, he says.
